Since 16 divides 32, the factorization identity implies
\[
3^{16}-2^{16}\mid 3^{32}-2^{32}.
\]
Also,
\[
3^{16}-2^{16}=(3^8-2^8)(3^8+2^8)=6305\cdot6817.
\]
Now
\[
6305=5\cdot13\cdot97,
\qquad 6817=17\cdot401.
\]
Therefore, each of 5, 13, 17, and 97 divides \(3^{16}-2^{16}\), and hence divides \(3^{32}-2^{32}\). They are all prime and less than 100. Thus the required four primes are
\[
\boxed{5,13,17,97}.
\]
